claims.claim: MTD for Income Tax applies from April 2026.
claims.quote: From 6 April 2026, sole traders and landlords must use it if their total annual income from self-employment and property is over £50,000.
claims.note: The source gives the start date of 6 April 2026.

claims.claim: MTD for Income Tax applies to sole traders and landlords.
claims.quote: Making Tax Digital for Income Tax is a new way for sole traders and landlords to report their income and expenses to HMRC.
claims.note: The source names sole traders and landlords.

claims.claim: It applies to those with income over £50,000.
claims.quote: From 6 April 2026, sole traders and landlords must use it if their total annual income from self-employment and property is over £50,000.
claims.note: The source states the £50,000 threshold on self-employment and property income.

claims.claim: A VAT registration number is needed to enrol for Making Tax Digital.
claims.note: The sources do not list a VAT registration number as needed to sign up; the withdrawn agent guidance mentions only a VAT certificate.
